_comment: Single source of truth for monokernel shapes. Each entry declares ONE compile-time specialization (the kernel is template-specialized on N/K/E, so a new shape needs a rebuild). The generator csrc/moe/moe_monokernel/tools/gen_shapes.py reads this and emits the C++ Dims structs / wrapper impls / op decls / torch bindings (as *.inc include files) plus the Python dispatch table. Shape-keyed op names are E{E}_N{N}_K{K}; legacy 35B/122B names are kept as aliases for back-compat. config[0] MUST be the shipped default (its knobs define the base Dims). UP_COL_HALVES is normally DERIVED from DCT: uch = max(1, 2*N*DCT/(128*K)); uch>=2 => raw two-TMA up-proj (no Python interleave). A shape MAY instead pin UP_COL_HALVES explicitly (optional per-shape 'up_col_halves' field) to DECOUPLE the up grid from the down grid when the coupling identity has no integer solution (UP_GROUPS != DOWN_GROUPS); such shapes use the expert-slot producer->consumer barrier at site #2 and are all-raw (never interleaved). top_k is a RUNTIME arg (1..8); the value here is only the tuner/serving default.

configs.note: default (KUP=256, 188KB); fastest on H200 BS8 M=1..8, see tune_monokernel

shapes._comment: DECOUPLED up/down carve. K=6144, N_half=256 has no coupled solution (the identity 2N/(128*UCH)=K/DCT forces DOWN_COL_TILE=1536 => 12 halves / ~384KB SHM). Pin UP_COL_HALVES=2 explicitly (raw two-TMA up-proj, NO Python interleave) so the up grid (UP_GRID=2*N/(128*UCH)=2, UP_GROUPS=64) is chosen independently of the down grid (DOWN_GRID=K/DCT=16, DOWN_GROUPS=8). Barrier ratio R=UP_GROUPS/DOWN_GROUPS=8; site #2 uses the expert-slot producer->consumer split (expert_produce_arrive / expert_consume_wait) instead of the coupled per-up_group expert_barrier. down-proj reduction dim is N=256 (K_TILES_DOWN = 256/KDN). All configs are raw (UCH>=2) so Python never interleaves w13.
shapes.display_name: E256 N_half256 K6144 decoupled block-wise FP8

configs.note: default (tuned 2026-07-02, H200 synthetic sweep: best at every M 1/2/4/8, 1.19x/1.19x/1.14x/1.05x vs Triton); UCH=2 raw, UP_GRID=2/UP_GROUPS=64, DOWN_GRID=16/DOWN_GROUPS=8, R=8; KUP=256 => 24 up K-steps; SHM~219KB
KUP=128 (48 up K-steps); lowest SHM ~187KB; former default
grid=112 partial (DOWN 16x7, UP_GROUPS=56); loses at M=8 (0.84x)
DCT=256: DOWN 24x5, UP_GROUPS=60; runner-up at M=1
DCT=128: DOWN 48x2, UP_GROUPS=48; loses badly at M>=4

shapes._comment: E-sweep shapes: 35B N/K (N_half=512, K=2048), varying expert count to exercise the generic E axis. Same config set as 35B (DCT 256 interleave cfg0-3, DCT 512 raw cfg4-5).
Onboarded via onboard_model.py for minimax_m2_5. Candidate configs from enum_configs; config 0 is the heuristic default — retune with tune_monokernel.py.
